text:
maya: Quick convo 1 — version timeline confirm UX. Two options: compact inline confirm vs small modal. Need keyboard + SR flow notes.

dave: Inline is faster but risky on mobile. Modal is safer and gives space for brief diff.

ellie: Copy: avoid 'panic' or 'rollback' in the default UI. Suggest 'Restore this version' for gentler tone.

maya: Agreed. Also keyboard focus: when confirm appears (inline or modal) focus must move to the confirm button and announce the change.

aria-bot: A11y checklist: 1) set focus to the confirm control; 2) use aria-live to announce "Confirm restore to vX.Y"; 3) toast must be focusable and include "Undo"; 4) Esc closes modal and returns focus to timeline item.

sam: For mobile, propose a 2-tap pattern: first tap reveals compact summary, second tap confirms. Prevents accidental taps.

dave: Telemetry: capture flow type (inline/modal), confirm time, undo rate, and device type. A/B 2 weeks.

ellie: Figma: I'll add 3 micro-mocks (inline two-state, anchored card, modal) with copy variations: "Restore this version", "Revert to this snapshot", "Return to this state".

maya: Action items: Design mocks by Tue, Eng to add telemetry flags and undo endpoint (30s), A11y to run SR walkthrough after prototype.

sam: +1. Also add keyboard shortcut hint in help modal for power users.

aria-bot: Accessibility review scheduled in 4 days.

maya: Thanks all, will post mocks and copy options in the thread.
